module: Node "Shift to Gear Index" (category `repeat_instant`). Shifts to a specific gear on a manual gearbox: `core_vehicleBridge.executeAction(veh,'shiftToGearIndex', gear)`. `gear`: 0 neutral, -1 reverse, 1 first, etc. Input pins: `vehId`, `gear`.
notes: Undefined behavior according to the code (node description) for an automatic gearbox or an out-of-range gear.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.
